title: Batched Git object reads for manifest validation
failure_signature: A closeout validation bundle timed out after launching a separate Git process for each logical and committed manifest entry in two validators.
trigger_preconditions: detailed and minimal validators in one command envelope
candidate_workaround: Read all requested commit blobs through one git cat-file batch and invoke detailed and minimal validators in separately observable commands.
recurrence_guard: Avoid per-entry process fanout for Git manifests; batch object reads and preserve each validator's independent result.
rollback: Retain the timed-out bundle, restore the prior validator if batch parsing changes bytes, and compare the same manifest hashes before promotion.
scope_boundary: Git object retrieval performance only; batching does not reduce the manifest, validation scope, or evidence gates.
